items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: when I walked in the door, Bill Hadnot was playing bass with -- ... And he was playing bass with Bus Moten Band.

ctx.x: But I didn't get to Omaha. I had to change buses in Kansas City. So I decided, I said, "Well, I'm going --" I had an hour layover in Kansas City. So I says, "I'm going to go up here to this Reno Club and see what they doing up there." So I walked in, when I walked in the door, Bill Hadnot was playing bass with --
Yeah. Bill went to the West Coast.
